verifiedFindings: MDEQ issued Solid Waste Disposal Area Construction Permit 4127 to Wexford County Landfill, LLC on August 20, 2012 for facility ID 470336.
The permit identifies the facility as a 196.40-acre municipal solid-waste and Type III industrial-waste landfill in Cedar Creek Township, Wexford County.

The permit authorizes construction under the incorporated 2012 application and engineering plans; it expressly states that the newly authorized disposal area could not accept solid waste until MDEQ issued an operating license.
The permit requires sampling under the Hydrogeological Monitoring Plan and submission of results to MDEQ's Cadillac District Office; it lists no variances and no special conditions.
Attachment A is the permit's site map and provides facility-layout context, not a measured contaminant pathway or proof of a Cadillac WWTP receiving transaction.
evidentiaryBoundary: This source establishes the 2012 landfill construction authorization and incorporated planning/monitoring framework.
